matched_queries: Employer responsibilities and worker rights: Voluntary equality action planning and using gender pay gap reports to set workplace improvement actions.
Discover UK employment guidance for Equality action plans: mandatory. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
When you submit your action plan, you will be asked to add:

supporting text for each action

a supporting narrative for your overall action plan

Your supporting narrative will be published alongside the data you report on the gender pay gap service. It can help people understand the underlying factors which may impact data, and provide context.

You should prepare this content before you submit your action plan.

Supporting text for each action

For each ‘new or in progress’ action you select, you must add further details about:

why your organisation has chosen this action

how you will track and understand whether this action is improving gender equality in your organisation

For actions you select that are ‘embedded’ – they are already an established part of your working practice – you can add further details about how your organisation made them an established part of their working practice. This might include:

how your organisation implemented this action

what the results have been

For each action you add to your plan, you:

can write up to 100 words of supporting text

cannot upload files, such as CSVs or PDFs

cannot add links

Supporting narrative for your overall action plan

You can add an overall supporting narrative with any background information. This might include your organisation’s objectives for gender equality. You can write up to 200 words. You cannot upload files.

We encourage you to ensure the information you include in your action plan is also available on your own website. When you create your action plan on the gender pay gap service, we will ask you to link to the relevant page – for example, to your organisation’s equality policies or strategies, if you have them.
